results.name: My Sassy Girl
results.overview: Lu Nanyi, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, and Lin Qingqiu, from a distinguished family, grew up as childhood sweethearts. However, Lin Qingqiu was betrothed to another due to his parents' arrangement, though he still loved Lu Nanyi. They planned to elope on his wedding day but were tricked into believing the other had abandoned them, leading to their heartbreaking separation. A year later, Lin Qingqiu became the magistrate of Jinzhou County, seeking Lu Nanyi, while she gained fame as a storywriter. A murder case in Liu Zhou mirrored Lu Nanyi's stories, putting her under suspicion. As Lin Qingqiu investigated, the former lovers reunited, rekindling their old flame amidst the tension of avenging their past heartbreaks. However, the quest for the real killer complicates their reunion and raises the question: can their fractured relationship truly heal?

results.name: My Sassy Girl
results.overview: Ryokiteki na Kanojo is a Japanese television drama based on the South Korean movie My Sassy Girl. It narrates the story between Saburo Masaki, a marine biologist, and Riko Takami, an aspiring writer with a short temper. While the two are at odds with each other at first, they eventually become attracted to each other and develop a relationship. It received an average of 8.18% viewer rating throughout the series.

results.title: My New Sassy Girl
results.overview: Gyun-woo is having difficulty forgetting the sassy girl. He then reunites with his childhood sweetheart, an elementary school classmate from China who was often teased about her broken Korean. They marry despite family opposition, and Gyun-woo has no idea what marriage has in store for him.

results.title: My Sassy Girl 2
results.overview: One month earlier, Shang Zhen (Lynn Hung) arrives in Seoul, South Korea, where she coincidentally meets Jian Yu (William Li), who had his marriage proposal rejected. Shang Zhen, who is still heartbroken, had a sudden idea: to use Jian Yu to sabotage her ex-boyfriend's wedding. Thus, Jian Yu follows Shang Zhen back to China, where she reveals her "wild" side.  Shang Zhen's cousin, Yong Zhen (Feng Yuanzhen), is also much of a headache for men. Working as a Taekwondo coach, Yong Zhen has a student named Zhi Kai (He Jiong) who lacks masculinity. Zhi Kai admires Yong Zhen greatly but often suffers under her fists and feet.  Jian Yu accompanies Shang Zhen in preparing for the wedding sabotage, but during a rehearsal, they offended a stranger. Meanwhile, the wedding date is fast approaching.  The film is an unofficial sequel of the 2001 South Korean film "My Sassy Girl".

results.name: Sassy Girl
results.overview: To support her orphanage, the quirky and kind-hearted Lu Yiyi takes a job as a security guard in a wealthy neighborhood. There, she unexpectedly encourages a troubled young boy, Su Yuchen. Years later, the two cross paths again—this time sparking a sweet and romantic relationship.

results.name: Kularb Rai Kong Naai Tawan
results.original_name: กุหลาบร้ายของนายตะวัน
results.overview: Rose, she is the heir of the Queen Rose Hotel. She was raised spoiled because she was the only the granddaughter of the president of Queen Rose Hotel. She was raised in England and graduated from there so, she look down on the low-class / or commoner people. Tawan, a farmer grandson who loves nature and enjoys to play with flowers, was hired to organized a welcome party for Rose, but she was displeased with his taste in choosing the flowers for the party. Therefore, she hates him from their first meet, but coincidentally their grandfathers are childhood friends and promised to let their grandson and granddaughter marry each other. However, Rose refused to marry Tawan, so her grandfather offers to go to work in the Tawan farm for one year but if she runs away before one year, she will have to marry him.

results.title: Blue Sky
results.overview: The story revolves around a pachinko parlor worker named Shiori (Aoi) and her aspiring musician boyfriend, Tetsu. The two of them travel from Kyushu to Tokyo together and struggle to stay afloat while Tetsu chases his dream. Tetsu’s younger brother eventually shows up and the two brothers form a duo and start to play some shows together. Later, Shiori gets recruited as a gravure idol while Tetsu gets involved with a local yakuza and cheats on Shiori with another woman. Tetsu continues loving Shiori, but big city life gradually tears them apart.
